source: Adobe Stock contributor help pages (photo requirements, generative-AI guidelines, quality standards) as returned by web search on 2026-09-29; the pages could not be fetched directly. Re-verify against the live pages before relying on these values.
notes: 45 MB is interpreted conservatively as 45,000,000 bytes.
Adobe asks contributors not to enlarge files in a way that degrades quality: every enlargement produces a warning.
Content changed by generative AI must be labelled by the contributor; the report provides a disclosure to support that decision.
Contributors must hold the rights to submit output of the AI tools used: non-commercial models are blocked.
